Grammar: 再 vs 又 in 先……，再/又……，然后…… (再 = action not yet happened; 又 = action already happened)
Grammar: 除了……以外，都…… (all except: the rest share the same situation; 以外 can be omitted)
Grammar: 除了……以外，还/也…… (besides: adds others; subject goes at start or before 还/也)

周末你们一般在哪儿吃饭？在家吃还是出去吃？ (Zhōumò nǐmen yìbān zài nǎr chī fàn? Zài jiā chī háishi chūqu chī?) - Where do you usually eat on weekends? Eat at home or go out to eat?
终于考完试了，我们去哪儿玩儿玩儿？ (Zhōngyú kǎo wán shì le, wǒmen qù nǎr wánr wanr?) - We've finally finished the exams, where shall we go to have some fun?
你应该早睡早起，别睡得那么晚。 (Nǐ yīnggāi zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ, bié shuì de nàme wǎn.) - You should go to bed early and get up early; don't go to bed so late.
我不愿意去那个公司工作，太远，也太累。 (Wǒ bú yuànyì qù nàge gōngsī gōngzuò, tài yuǎn, yě tài lèi.) - I am not willing to work at that company; it's too far and too tiring.
那个饭馆离我们学校很近，我们经常去。 (Nàge fànguǎn lí wǒmen xuéxiào hěn jìn, wǒmen jīngcháng qù.) - That restaurant is very close to our school; we often go there.
一会儿周经理走进来的时候，请大家站起来。 (Yíhuìr Zhōu jīnglǐ zǒu jìnlai de shíhou, qǐng dàjiā zhàn qǐlai.) - When Manager Zhou walks in in a moment, please everyone stand up.
好，我们知道了。 (Hǎo, wǒmen zhīdào le.) - OK, we understand.
我忘了把这本书还给他了。 (Wǒ wàng le bǎ zhè běn shū huán gěi tā le.) - I forgot to return this book to him.
没关系，明天我帮你送过去吧。 (Méi guānxi, míngtiān wǒ bāng nǐ sòng guòqu ba.) - It doesn't matter, I'll take it over for you tomorrow.
前边那位老人是谁？ (Qiánbian nà wèi lǎorén shì shéi?) - Who is that old man in front?
他是我们的校长。 (Tā shì wǒmen de xiàozhǎng.) - He is our principal.
你怎么回来这么晚？ (Nǐ zěnme huílai zhème wǎn?) - Why did you come back so late?
回家的路上遇到张老师了，跟他聊了一会儿。 (Huí jiā de lùshang yùdào Zhāng lǎoshī le, gēn tā liáo le yíhuìr.) - On the way home I ran into Teacher Zhang and chatted with him for a while.
下个月是爷爷的生日，你有什么打算？ (Xià ge yuè shì yéye de shēngrì, nǐ yǒu shénme dǎsuàn?) - Next month is Grandpa's birthday, what are your plans?
我要送他一件特别的礼物。 (Wǒ yào sòng tā yí jiàn tèbié de lǐwù.) - I want to give him a special gift.
一会儿有朋友过来吗？ (Yíhuìr yǒu péngyou guòlai ma?) - Are friends coming over in a little while?
好，我马上去买。 (Hǎo, wǒ mǎshàng qù mǎi.) - OK, I'll go and buy it right away.
饭做好了！ (Fàn zuò hǎo le!) - The meal is ready!
好，我跟你一起去。 (Hǎo, wǒ gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù.) - OK, I'll go with you.
对，他刚从国外回来。 (Duì, tā gāng cóng guówài huílai.) - Yes, he has just come back from abroad.
这是什么？ (Zhè shì shénme?) - What is this?
小刚买了什么礼物回来？ (Xiǎogāng mǎi le shénme lǐwù huílai?) - What gift did Xiaogang buy and bring back?
小刚今天做什么了？ (Xiǎogāng jīntiān zuò shénme le?) - What did Xiaogang do today?
小刚为什么很晚才回家？ (Xiǎogāng wèi shénme hěn wǎn cái huí jiā?) - Why did Xiaogang get home so late?
小丽更喜欢看电视还是看电影？ (Xiǎolì gèng xǐhuan kàn diànshì háishi kàn diànyǐng?) - Does Xiaoli prefer watching TV or watching movies?
为什么？ (Wèi shénme?) - Why?
刚结婚的时候，丈夫习惯做什么？ (Gāng jié hūn de shíhou, zhàngfu xíguàn zuò shénme?) - When they had just got married, what was the husband used to doing?
现在丈夫的生活什么样？ (Xiànzài zhàngfu de shēnghuó shénme yàng?) - What is the husband's life like now?

上下结构的形声字有两种，一种是“上形下声”，也就是形旁在上边，声旁在下边。 (Shàngxià jiégòu de xíngshēngzì yǒu liǎng zhǒng, yì zhǒng shì “shàng xíng xià shēng”, yě jiù shì xíngpáng zài shàngbian, shēngpáng zài xiàbian.) - There are two types of top-bottom pictophonetic characters; one is "semantic on top, phonetic at the bottom", i.e. the semantic component is on the top and the phonetic component at the bottom.

另一种是“下形上声”，也就是声旁在上边，形旁在下边。 (Lìng yì zhǒng shì “xià xíng shàng shēng”, yě jiù shì shēngpáng zài shàngbian, xíngpáng zài xiàbian.) - The other type is "phonetic on top, semantic at the bottom", i.e. the phonetic component is on the top and the semantic component at the bottom.
我经常一边开车一边打电话。 (Wǒ jīngcháng yìbiān kāi chē yìbiān dǎ diànhuà.) - I often make phone calls while driving.
你不能一边开车一边打电话。 (Nǐ bù néng yìbiān kāi chē yìbiān dǎ diànhuà.) - You must not make phone calls while driving.
我会给妈妈带回来一条红色的裙子。 (Wǒ huì gěi māma dài huílai yì tiáo hóngsè de qúnzi.) - I will bring back a red skirt for my mother.
因为她最喜欢红色。 (Yīnwèi tā zuì xǐhuan hóngsè.) - Because she likes red the most.

“礼轻情意重”，这句话的意思是虽然礼物很轻，但是表达的情意非常深厚。 (“Lǐ qīng qíngyì zhòng”, zhè jù huà de yìsi shì suīrán lǐwù hěn qīng, dànshì biǎodá de qíngyì fēicháng shēnhòu.) - "礼轻情意重" means that although the gift itself is light, the goodwill it conveys is very deep.

现在常用来比喻送礼时礼物大小没关系，表达最真挚的情意才是最重要的。 (Xiànzài cháng yòng lái bǐyù sòng lǐ shí lǐwù dàxiǎo méi guānxi, biǎodá zuì zhēnzhì de qíngyì cái shì zuì zhòngyào de.) - Now it is often used to mean that when giving a gift the size of the gift does not matter; expressing the most sincere feelings is what matters most.
客人就要来了，你怎么还不打扫房间啊？ (Kèrén jiù yào lái le, nǐ zěnme hái bù dǎsǎo fángjiān a?) - The guests are about to arrive, why haven't you cleaned the room yet?

别着急，我让孩子们打扫呢，客人来的时候，他们会把房间打扫干净。 (Bié zháojí, wǒ ràng háizimen dǎsǎo ne, kèrén lái de shíhou, tāmen huì bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo gānjìng.) - Don't worry, I'm having the children clean it; when the guests come, they will have the room cleaned.
那你也不能看电视啊。 (Nà nǐ yě bù néng kàn diànshì a.) - Then you shouldn't be watching TV either.
你让我做什么？ (Nǐ ràng wǒ zuò shénme?) - What do you want me to do?
先把茶和杯子放好，然后把冰箱里的西瓜拿出来。 (Xiān bǎ chá hé bēizi fànghǎo, ránhòu bǎ bīngxiāng li de xīguā ná chulai.) - First put the tea and cups in place, then take the watermelon out of the refrigerator.
太热了，我还是先把空调打开吧。 (Tài rè le, wǒ háishi xiān bǎ kōngtiáo dǎ kāi ba.) - It's too hot, I'd better turn on the air conditioning first.
你在忙什么呢？ (Nǐ zài máng shénme ne?) - What are you busy with?
刚才打你的手机你也不接。 (Gāngcái dǎ nǐ de shǒujī nǐ yě bù jiē.) - I called your mobile phone just now and you didn't answer.
对不起，我刚洗了个澡，没听见。 (Duìbuqǐ, wǒ gāng xǐle ge zǎo, méi tīngjiàn.) - Sorry, I just took a shower and didn't hear it.
有什么事吗？ (Yǒu shénme shì ma?) - Is there something the matter?
我想问问你公司里的一些事情。 (Wǒ xiǎng wènwen nǐ gōngsī li de yìxiē shìqing.) - I'd like to ask you about some things at the company.
你先等一下，我去把电视关了。 (Nǐ xiān děng yíxià, wǒ qù bǎ diànshì guān le.) - Wait a moment first, I'll go and turn off the TV.
没关系，你先把电视节目看完吧，然后再给我回电话。 (Méi guānxi, nǐ xiān bǎ diànshì jiémù kànwán ba, ránhòu zài gěi wǒ huí diànhuà.) - It doesn't matter, finish watching the TV programme first, and then call me back.
今晚的月亮真漂亮，像白色的盘子一样。 (Jīn wǎn de yuèliang zhēn piàoliang, xiàng báisè de pánzi yíyàng.) - The moon tonight is really beautiful, like a white plate.

是啊，外边也不刮风，我们坐在外边一边看月亮一边吃东西，怎么样？ (Shì a, wàibian yě bù guā fēng, wǒmen zuò zài wàibian yìbiān kàn yuèliang yìbiān chī dōngxi, zěnme yàng?) - Yes, and it's not windy outside either; how about sitting outside, looking at the moon while eating?

好啊，我先把桌椅搬出去，然后你把水果拿过来，我们听叔叔阿姨讲讲他们年轻时候的故事。 (Hǎo a, wǒ xiān bǎ zhuōyǐ bān chuqu, ránhòu nǐ bǎ shuǐguǒ ná guolai, wǒmen tīng shūshu āyí jiǎngjiang tāmen niánqīng shíhou de gùshì.) - Good, I'll first move the tables and chairs out, then you bring the fruit over, and we'll listen to Uncle and Aunt tell stories of when they were young.
太好了！ (Tài hǎo le!) - Great!
记得给大山打个电话，让他马上过来。 (Jìde gěi Dàshān dǎ ge diànhuà, ràng tā mǎshàng guòlai.) - Remember to call Dashan and have him come over right away.
不用打了，你听外边的声音，一定是大山。 (Búyòng dǎ le, nǐ tīng wàibian de shēngyīn, yídìng shì Dàshān.) - No need to call, listen to the sound outside, it must be Dashan.
你吃过水果饭吗？ (Nǐ chī guo shuǐguǒ fàn ma?) - Have you ever eaten fruit rice?
你在饭馆的菜单上见过水果饭吗？ (Nǐ zài fànguǎnr de càidān shang jiàn guo shuǐguǒ fàn ma?) - Have you ever seen fruit rice on a restaurant menu?
你想学着做水果饭吗？ (Nǐ xiǎng xuézhe zuò shuǐguǒ fàn ma?) - Do you want to learn to make fruit rice?

其实做水果饭很简单，先把米饭做好，然后再把一块块新鲜的水果放进去，水果饭就做好了。 (Qíshí zuò shuǐguǒ fàn hěn jiǎndān, xiān bǎ mǐfàn zuòhǎo, ránhòu zài bǎ yí kuàikuài xīnxiān de shuǐguǒ fàng jinqu, shuǐguǒ fàn jiù zuòhǎo le.) - Actually making fruit rice is very simple: first cook the rice, then put pieces of fresh fruit into it, and the fruit rice is done.

你可以做苹果饭、香蕉饭，要是你愿意，还可以做西瓜饭。 (Nǐ kěyǐ zuò píngguǒ fàn, xiāngjiāo fàn, yàoshi nǐ yuànyì, hái kěyǐ zuò xīguā fàn.) - You can make apple rice and banana rice, and if you like you can also make watermelon rice.
多吃新鲜水果对身体好。 (Duō chī xīnxiān shuǐguǒ duì shēntǐ hǎo.) - Eating more fresh fruit is good for your health.
我把衣服洗干净了。 (Wǒ bǎ yīfu xǐ gānjìng le.) - I have washed the clothes clean.
妈妈还没把饭做好呢。 (Māma hái méi bǎ fàn zuòhǎo ne.) - Mum hasn't finished cooking the meal yet.
请同学们把铅笔拿出来。 (Qǐng tóngxuémen bǎ qiānbǐ ná chulai.) - Students, please take out your pencils.
你把水果拿过来。 (Nǐ bǎ shuǐguǒ ná guolai.) - Bring the fruit over here.
妈妈，让我再看一会儿这个节目吧。 (Māma, ràng wǒ zài kàn yíhuìr zhège jiémù ba.) - Mum, let me watch this programme a little longer.
房间里太热了。 (Fángjiān li tài rè le.) - It's too hot in the room.
我的行李呢？ (Wǒ de xíngli ne?) - Where is my luggage?
回家以后，我先做作业，然后吃饭。 (Huí jiā yǐhòu, wǒ xiān zuò zuòyè, ránhòu chī fàn.) - After getting home, I first do my homework and then eat.

我先坐了一个小时公共汽车，又坐了一会儿地铁才到小刚家。 (Wǒ xiān zuò le yí ge xiǎoshí gōnggòng qìchē, yòu zuò le yíhuìr dìtiě cái dào Xiǎogāng jiā.) - I first took the bus for an hour, then took the subway for a while before I got to Xiaogang's home.
你先把电视节目看完吧，然后再给我回电话。 (Nǐ xiān bǎ diànshì jiémù kànwán ba, ránhòu zài gěi wǒ huí diànhuà.) - Finish watching the TV programme first, and then call me back.
先把米饭做好，然后再把一块块新鲜的水果放进去。 (Xiān bǎ mǐfàn zuòhǎo, ránhòu zài bǎ yí kuàikuài xīnxiān de shuǐguǒ fàng jinqu.) - First cook the rice, then put pieces of fresh fruit into it.
下课以后，你做什么？ (Xià kè yǐhòu, nǐ zuò shénme?) - What do you do after class?
你妈妈来了，你打算带她去哪儿玩儿？ (Nǐ māma lái le, nǐ dǎsuàn dài tā qù nǎr wánr?) - Your mother has come; where do you plan to take her to have fun?
考完试了，你有什么打算？ (Kǎo wán shì le, nǐ yǒu shénme dǎsuàn?) - The exams are over; what are your plans?
你怎么还不打扫房间啊？ (Nǐ zěnme hái bù dǎsǎo fángjiān a?) - Why haven't you cleaned the room yet?
他们会把房间打扫干净。 (Tāmen huì bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo gānjìng.) - They will clean the room until it is clean.
我刚洗了个澡。 (Wǒ gāng xǐ le ge zǎo.) - I just took a shower.
请看下一个节目。 (Qǐng kàn xià yí ge jiémù.) - Please watch the next programme.
你先把电视节目看完吧。 (Nǐ xiān bǎ diànshì jiémù kànwán ba.) - Finish watching the TV programme first.
外面没刮风。 (Wàimian méi guā fēng.) - It isn't windy outside.
每天晚上，爸爸都要给女儿讲一个故事。 (Měi tiān wǎnshang, bàba dōu yào gěi nǚ'ér jiǎng yí ge gùshì.) - Every evening, Dad tells his daughter a story.
我来做饭，你来洗盘子，怎么样？ (Wǒ lái zuò fàn, nǐ lái xǐ pánzi, zěnme yàng?) - I'll cook, and you wash the plates, how about it?
我们买几斤香蕉吧，家里没有水果了。 (Wǒmen mǎi jǐ jīn xiāngjiāo ba, jiāli méiyǒu shuǐguǒ le.) - Let's buy a few jin of bananas; there is no fruit at home.
跟朋友一起喝着饮料看电视节目，是最快乐的事。 (Gēn péngyou yìqǐ hē zhe yǐnliào kàn diànshì jiémù, shì zuì kuàilè de shì.) - Drinking beverages and watching TV programmes with friends is the happiest thing.
服务员，请拿菜单过来，我们点菜。 (Fúwùyuán, qǐng ná càidān guòlai, wǒmen diǎn cài.) - Waiter, please bring the menu over; we'd like to order.
我们什么时候吃晚饭？ (Wǒmen shénme shíhou chī wǎnfàn?) - When do we have dinner?
先打扫完房间再吃。 (Xiān dǎsǎo wán fángjiān zài chī.) - Eat after first finishing cleaning the room.
听！是谁在外边说话？ (Tīng! Shì shéi zài wàibian shuō huà?) - Listen! Who is talking outside?
没有声音啊。 (Méiyǒu shēngyīn a.) - There's no sound.
你觉得洗衣服很简单，可我觉得很难。 (Nǐ juéde xǐ yīfu hěn jiǎndān, kě wǒ juéde hěn nán.) - You think washing clothes is very simple, but I think it is very hard.
那你觉得做什么不难呢？ (Nà nǐ juéde zuò shénme bù nán ne?) - Then what do you think is not hard to do?
那么多衣服，终于洗完了！ (Nàme duō yīfu, zhōngyú xǐ wán le!) - So many clothes, finally all washed!
都洗干净了吗？ (Dōu xǐ gānjìng le ma?) - Are they all washed clean?
这个地方真美！ (Zhège dìfang zhēn měi!) - This place is really beautiful!
是啊，像画儿一样。 (Shì a, xiàng huàr yíyàng.) - Yes, it's just like a painting.
今天下午你做什么？ (Jīntiān xiàwǔ nǐ zuò shénme?) - What are you doing this afternoon?
你要走了？ (Nǐ yào zǒu le?) - You're leaving?
不吃了，我要迟到了。 (Bù chī le, wǒ yào chídào le.) - I won't eat; I'm going to be late.
今天你下了课就回家吧。 (Jīntiān nǐ xià le kè jiù huí jiā ba.) - Go straight home after class today.
今天是周末，你可以休息了吧？ (Jīntiān shì zhōumò, nǐ kěyǐ xiūxi le ba?) - Today is the weekend, so you can rest now, right?
小刚，你现在去哪儿？ (Xiǎogāng, nǐ xiànzài qù nǎr?) - Xiaogang, where are you going now?
我明天要去上海，你帮我准备一下。 (Wǒ míngtiān yào qù Shànghǎi, nǐ bāng wǒ zhǔnbèi yíxià.) - I'm going to Shanghai tomorrow; please help me prepare.
周明在做什么？ (Zhōu Míng zài zuò shénme?) - What is Zhou Ming doing?
他太太想让他做什么？ (Tā tàitai xiǎng ràng tā zuò shénme?) - What does his wife want him to do?
小刚为什么没接电话？ (Xiǎogāng wèi shénme méi jiē diànhuà?) - Why didn't Xiaogang answer the phone?
同事为什么给小刚打电话？ (Tóngshì wèi shénme gěi Xiǎogāng dǎ diànhuà?) - Why did the colleague call Xiaogang?
小明和同学打算做什么？ (Xiǎomíng hé tóngxué dǎsuàn zuò shénme?) - What do Xiaoming and his classmate plan to do?
怎么做水果饭？ (Zěnme zuò shuǐguǒ fàn?) - How do you make fruit rice?
为什么要多吃水果？ (Wèi shénme yào duō chī shuǐguǒ?) - Why should one eat more fruit?

从雍和宫到王府井，先坐5号线到东单，然后换1号线到王府井。 (Cóng Yōnghégōng dào Wángfǔjǐng, xiān zuò wǔ hào xiàn dào Dōngdān, ránhòu huàn yī hào xiàn dào Wángfǔjǐng.) - From Yonghegong to Wangfujing, first take Line 5 to Dongdan, then transfer to Line 1 to Wangfujing.
(1) 从雍和宫到王府井 - From Yonghegong to Wangfujing
(2) 从东四十条到天安门西 - From Dongsishitiao to Tian'anmen West
(3) 从西直门到天安门东 - From Xizhimen to Tian'anmen East
(4) 从前门到北海北 - From Qianmen to Beihai North
(5) 从北京站到西四 - From Beijing Railway Station to Xisi
(6) 从和平门到北海北 - From Hepingmen to Beihai North
怎么把羊、花儿、老虎送到河对面？ (Zěnme bǎ yáng, huār, lǎohǔ sòng dào hé duìmiàn?) - How can the sheep, the flowers and the tiger be sent to the other side of the river?
老虎吃羊，羊吃花儿。 (Lǎohǔ chī yáng, yáng chī huār.) - The tiger eats sheep, and sheep eat flowers.
“先到先得”，这里“先”是早的意思。 (“Xiān dào xiān dé”, zhèlǐ “xiān” shì zǎo de yìsi.) - In "先到先得" (first come, first served), "先" means "early".

这句话的意思是东西有限，到得早的人就能得到，到晚了就没有了。 (Zhè jù huà de yìsi shì dōngxi yǒuxiàn, dào de zǎo de rén jiù néng dédào, dào wǎn le jiù méiyǒu le.) - The saying means that the amount of something is limited; those who arrive early can get it, and those who arrive late won't.

现在一般用来比喻做事要积极主动，及早准备，及早动手。 (Xiànzài yìbān yòng lái bǐyù zuò shì yào jījí zhǔdòng, jízǎo zhǔnbèi, jízǎo dòngshǒu.) - Now it is generally used to mean that one should be proactive and prepare and start as early as possible.

老师，我来中国留学两年了，但是我的汉语水平提高得一点儿也不快啊。 (Lǎoshī, wǒ lái Zhōngguó liú xué liǎng nián le, dànshì wǒ de Hànyǔ shuǐpíng tí gāo de yìdiǎnr yě bú kuài a.) - Teacher, I have been studying in China for two years, but my Chinese level has not improved quickly at all.

你每天认真学习，做练习、完成作业，一直不错啊。 (Nǐ měi tiān rènzhēn xuéxí, zuò liànxí, wán chéng zuòyè, yìzhí búcuò a.) - You study seriously every day, do exercises and finish your homework; you have always been doing well.
这是我昨天的作业，您帮我看看对不对。 (Zhè shì wǒ zuótiān de zuòyè, nín bāng wǒ kànkan duì bu duì.) - This is my homework from yesterday; please help me check if it's right.

写得不错，除了这个句子意思有些不清楚外，其他都没什么问题。 (Xiě de búcuò, chúle zhège jùzi yìsi yǒuxiē bù qīngchu wài, qítā dōu méi shénme wèntí.) - It's well written; apart from the meaning of this sentence being a bit unclear, the rest has no problems.
谢谢老师！ (Xièxie lǎoshī!) - Thank you, teacher!

以后有什么不明白的地方，可以给我打电话或者发电子邮件。 (Yǐhòu yǒu shénme bù míngbai de dìfang, kěyǐ gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà huòzhě fā diànzǐ yóujiàn.) - If there is anything you don't understand in future, you can call me or send me an email.
老师，除了小云，其他人都来了。 (Lǎoshī, chúle Xiǎoyún, qítā rén dōu lái le.) - Teacher, everyone has come except Xiaoyun.
比赛马上就要开始了，小云怎么还没来？ (Bǐsài mǎshàng jiù yào kāishǐ le, Xiǎoyún zěnme hái méi lái?) - The competition is about to start; why hasn't Xiaoyun come yet?
刚才给她打电话了，她在路上呢。 (Gāngcái gěi tā dǎ diànhuà le, tā zài lùshang ne.) - I called her just now; she is on the way.

不等她了，我先给大家讲讲这次比赛的要求和一些需要注意的地方。 (Bù děng tā le, wǒ xiān gěi dàjiā jiǎngjiang zhè cì bǐsài de yāoqiú hé yìxiē xūyào zhù yì de dìfang.) - We won't wait for her; let me first tell everyone about the requirements of this competition and some points that need attention.
老师，您放心，今天的比赛我们一定能拿第一。 (Lǎoshī, nín fàngxīn, jīntiān de bǐsài wǒmen yídìng néng ná dì yī.) - Teacher, don't worry, we will definitely win first place in today's competition.
现在用电脑上网真方便啊！ (Xiànzài yòng diànnǎo shàng wǎng zhēn fāngbiàn a!) - It's really convenient to go online with a computer now!

是啊，除了看新闻，人们还可以在网上听歌、看电影、买东西。 (Shì a, chúle kàn xīnwén, rénmen hái kěyǐ zài wǎngshang tīng gē, kàn diànyǐng, mǎi dōngxi.) - Yes, besides reading the news, people can also listen to songs, watch movies and shop online.
对了，你从网上买的那件衣服呢？ (Duìle, nǐ cóng wǎngshang mǎi de nà jiàn yīfu ne?) - By the way, where is the piece of clothing you bought online?
怎么没见你穿？ (Zěnme méi jiàn nǐ chuān?) - Why haven't I seen you wearing it?
那件衣服我穿着有点儿小，给我弟弟了。 (Nà jiàn yīfu wǒ chuānzhe yǒudiǎnr xiǎo, gěi wǒ dìdi le.) - That piece of clothing was a bit small for me, so I gave it to my younger brother.
他满意吗？ (Tā mǎnyì ma?) - Is he satisfied?
不用花钱，还有新衣服穿，他满意极了。 (Búyòng huā qián, hái yǒu xīn yīfu chuān, tā mǎnyì jí le.) - He doesn't have to spend money and still has new clothes to wear; he is extremely satisfied.

除了春节、中秋节以外，啤酒节也是这里很重要的一个节日。 (Chúle Chūnjié, Zhōngqiū Jié yǐwài, píjiǔ jié yě shì zhèli hěn zhòngyào de yí ge jiérì.) - Besides the Spring Festival and Mid-Autumn Festival, the Beer Festival is also a very important festival here.
这个地方每年夏天都要举行一次啤酒节。 (Zhège dìfang měi nián xiàtiān dōu yào jǔxíng yí cì píjiǔ jié.) - This place holds a Beer Festival every summer.
在啤酒节上，你可以喝到世界上不同地方的啤酒。 (Zài píjiǔ jié shang, nǐ kěyǐ hēdào shìjiè shang bùtóng dìfang de píjiǔ.) - At the Beer Festival, you can drink beers from different places around the world.

除了喝啤酒，你还可以在街道两边看到世界上不同地方的歌舞。 (Chúle hē píjiǔ, nǐ hái kěyǐ zài jiēdào liǎng biān kàndào shìjiè shang bùtóng dìfang de gēwǔ.) - Besides drinking beer, you can also see songs and dances from different places around the world on both sides of the street.
你想不想了解世界各个地方的啤酒文化？ (Nǐ xiǎng bu xiǎng liǎojiě shìjiè gègè dìfang de píjiǔ wénhuà?) - Do you want to learn about the beer culture of places all over the world?
来这里的啤酒节看看吧。 (Lái zhèli de píjiǔ jié kànkan ba.) - Come and take a look at the Beer Festival here.
除了这个汉字以外，别的汉字我都认识。 (Chúle zhège Hànzì yǐwài, bié de Hànzì wǒ dōu rènshi.) - Except for this character, I know all the other characters.
除了我以外，大家都听懂了。 (Chúle wǒ yǐwài, dàjiā dōu tīngdǒng le.) - Except for me, everyone understood.
除了这个句子意思有些不清楚外，其他都没什么问题。 (Chúle zhège jùzi yìsi yǒuxiē bù qīngchu wài, qítā dōu méi shénme wèntí.) - Apart from the meaning of this sentence being a bit unclear, the rest has no problems.
除了小云，其他人都来了。 (Chúle Xiǎoyún, qítā rén dōu lái le.) - Everyone has come except Xiaoyun.
除了唱歌以外，他还喜欢跳舞。 (Chúle chàng gē yǐwài, tā hái xǐhuan tiào wǔ.) - Besides singing, he also likes dancing.
除了汉语以外，我还会说英语。 (Chúle Hànyǔ yǐwài, wǒ hái huì shuō Yīngyǔ.) - Besides Chinese, I can also speak English.
上网除了看新闻，还可以听音乐。 (Shàng wǎng chúle kàn xīnwén, hái kěyǐ tīng yīnyuè.) - Besides reading the news, going online also lets you listen to music.

除了春节、中秋节以外，啤酒节也是这里很重要的一个节日。 (Chúle Chūnjié, Zhōngqiū Jié yǐwài, píjiǔ jié yě shì zhèli hěn zhòngyào de yí ge jiérì.) - Besides the Spring Festival and Mid-Autumn Festival, the Beer Festival is also a very important festival here.
春节很重要，中秋节也是很重要的节日。 (Chūnjié hěn zhòngyào, Zhōngqiū Jié yě shì hěn zhòngyào de jiérì.) - The Spring Festival is important, and the Mid-Autumn Festival is also an important festival.
除了春节以外，中秋节也是很重要的节日。 (Chúle Chūnjié yǐwài, Zhōngqiū Jié yě shì hěn zhòngyào de jiérì.) - Besides the Spring Festival, the Mid-Autumn Festival is also an important festival.
我喜欢春天，也喜欢夏天。 (Wǒ xǐhuan chūntiān, yě xǐhuan xiàtiān.) - I like spring and I also like summer.
我们班只有王老师是中国人，其他人都是外国人。 (Wǒmen bān zhǐyǒu Wáng lǎoshī shì Zhōngguó rén, qítā rén dōu shì wàiguó rén.) - In our class only Teacher Wang is Chinese; the others are all foreigners.
我只想吃西瓜，其他水果都不想吃。 (Wǒ zhǐ xiǎng chī xīguā, qítā shuǐguǒ dōu bù xiǎng chī.) - I only want to eat watermelon; I don't want to eat any other fruit.
这个饭馆有没有什么特别好吃的菜？ (Zhège fànguǎn yǒu méiyǒu shénme tèbié hǎochī de cài?) - Does this restaurant have any especially delicious dishes?
周末你有没有什么打算？ (Zhōumò nǐ yǒu méiyǒu shénme dǎsuàn?) - Do you have any plans for the weekend?
你写得很好，没什么问题。 (Nǐ xiě de hěn hǎo, méi shénme wèntí.) - You write very well; there are no problems.

以后有什么不明白的地方，可以给我打电话或者发电子邮件。 (Yǐhòu yǒu shénme bù míngbai de dìfang, kěyǐ gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà huòzhě fā diànzǐ yóujiàn.) - If there is anything you don't understand in future, you can call me or send me an email.
周末我跟朋友打算去爬山。 (Zhōumò wǒ gēn péngyou dǎsuàn qù pá shān.) - This weekend I plan to go climbing with friends.
对不起，我很少看电影，不知道哪个好看。 (Duìbuqǐ, wǒ hěn shǎo kàn diànyǐng, bù zhīdào nǎge hǎokàn.) - Sorry, I rarely watch movies, so I don't know which one is good.
没有了，老师，我都懂了。 (Méiyǒu le, lǎoshī, wǒ dōu dǒng le.) - No more, teacher; I understand everything.
我的小狗可爱极了。 (Wǒ de xiǎo gǒu kě'ài jí le.) - My puppy is extremely cute.
今天天气冷极了。 (Jīntiān tiānqì lěng jí le.) - The weather today is extremely cold.
那件衣服我喜欢极了。 (Nà jiàn yīfu wǒ xǐhuan jí le.) - I like that piece of clothing extremely.
他满意极了。 (Tā mǎnyì jí le.) - He is extremely satisfied.
除了小云，其他人都来了。 (Chúle Xiǎoyún, qítā rén dōu lái le.) - Everyone has come except Xiaoyun.
我的汉语水平提高得一点儿也不快。 (Wǒ de Hànyǔ shuǐpíng tí gāo de yìdiǎnr yě bú kuài.) - My Chinese level has not improved quickly at all.
你每天认真学习，做练习、完成作业。 (Nǐ měi tiān rènzhēn xuéxí, zuò liànxí, wán chéng zuòyè.) - You study seriously every day, do exercises and complete your homework.
现在用电脑上网真方便啊！ (Xiànzài yòng diànnǎo shàng wǎng zhēn fāngbiàn a!) - It's really convenient to go online with a computer now!
我给大家讲讲需要注意的地方。 (Wǒ gěi dàjiā jiǎngjiang xūyào zhù yì de dìfang.) - Let me tell everyone about the points that need attention.
王经理，电子邮件我已经给您发过去了。 (Wáng jīnglǐ, diànzǐ yóujiàn wǒ yǐjīng gěi nín fā guòqu le.) - Manager Wang, I have already sent the email over to you.
你每天跟谁练习口语？ (Nǐ měi tiān gēn shéi liànxí kǒuyǔ?) - Who do you practise spoken Chinese with every day?
已经夜里12点多了，但是今天的作业我还没完成。 (Yǐjīng yèli shí'èr diǎn duō le, dànshì jīntiān de zuòyè wǒ hái méi wán chéng.) - It is already past 12 at night, but I haven't finished today's homework.
这个月我的钱都花完了，不能再买新衣服了。 (Zhège yuè wǒ de qián dōu huā wán le, bù néng zài mǎi xīn yīfu le.) - I have spent all my money this month and can't buy any more new clothes.
我在这里只学了三个月汉语，但是水平提高了不少。 (Wǒ zài zhèlǐ zhǐ xué le sān ge yuè Hànyǔ, dànshì shuǐpíng tígāo le bù shǎo.) - I have studied Chinese here for only three months, but my level has improved a lot.
今天听写五个句子，请大家准备好笔和纸。 (Jīntiān tīngxiě wǔ ge jùzi, qǐng dàjiā zhǔnbèi hǎo bǐ hé zhǐ.) - Today we will do dictation of five sentences; please get your pens and paper ready.
五个？老师，太多了！ (Wǔ ge? Lǎoshī, tài duō le!) - Five? Teacher, that's too many!
世界上有多少个国家？你知道吗？ (Shìjiè shang yǒu duōshao ge guójiā? Nǐ zhīdào ma?) - How many countries are there in the world? Do you know?
这个……，我真不知道。 (Zhège……, wǒ zhēn bù zhīdào.) - Um..., I really don't know.
你为什么想去那个地方旅游？ (Nǐ wèi shénme xiǎng qù nàge dìfang lǚyóu?) - Why do you want to travel to that place?
我对那儿的文化很感兴趣。 (Wǒ duì nàr de wénhuà hěn gǎn xìngqù.) - I am very interested in the culture there.
你们国家最重要的节日是什么？ (Nǐmen guójiā zuì zhòngyào de jiérì shì shénme?) - What is the most important festival in your country?
当然是春节！ (Dāngrán shì Chūnjié!) - Of course it's the Spring Festival!
刚才电视上的那条新闻真有意思！ (Gāngcái diànshì shang de nà tiáo xīnwén zhēn yǒu yìsi!) - The news item on TV just now was really interesting!
你快说说。 (Nǐ kuài shuōshuo.) - Quick, tell me about it.
这儿的鱼做得最好。 (Zhèr de yú zuò de zuì hǎo.) - The fish is cooked best here.
这儿有一些咖啡。 (Zhèr yǒu yìxiē kāfēi.) - There is some coffee here.
那边还有牛奶和茶。 (Nàbiān hái yǒu niúnǎi hé chá.) - Over there there is also milk and tea.
好的，大家一起努力。 (Hǎo de, dàjiā yìqǐ nǔlì.) - OK, let's all work hard together.
老师觉得大山的汉语怎么样？ (Lǎoshī juéde Dàshān de Hànyǔ zěnmeyàng?) - What does the teacher think of Dashan's Chinese?
大家都来参加比赛了吗？ (Dàjiā dōu lái cānjiā bǐsài le ma?) - Has everyone come to take part in the competition?
谁没来？ (Shéi méi lái?) - Who didn't come?
老师现在在做什么？ (Lǎoshī xiànzài zài zuò shénme?) - What is the teacher doing now?
大家可以上网做什么？ (Dàjiā kěyǐ shàng wǎng zuò shénme?) - What can people do online?
小刚从网上买的那件衣服怎么了？ (Xiǎogāng cóng wǎngshang mǎi de nà jiàn yīfu zěnme le?) - What happened to the clothes Xiaogang bought online?
啤酒节上可以做什么？ (Píjiǔ jié shang kěyǐ zuò shénme?) - What can one do at the Beer Festival?

hyperedges.label: Lesson 14 sequence-of-actions teaching unit (把 sentence 3 + 先……再/又……然后……)
除了……以外 structure family (all except / besides)
Pictophonetic characters 2 (爸, 苹, 想, 努)
